locator: Fingrid news (damaged on Christmas Day; expected back 20 June); ERR https://news.err.ee/1609709739/estlink-2-power-cable-to-resume-service-in-late-june-ahead-of-schedule (June 25; cost EUR 50-60m; mid-July earlier estimate)

description: Balticconnector gas pipeline (Finland-Estonia) damaged October 2023 by anchor (NewNew Polar Bear); commercial service resumed 22 April 2024; repair cost about EUR 35 million

description: Tamar gas platform shut by Israeli Energy Ministry order on 9 Oct 2023 (proximity to fighting); production resumed 13 Nov 2023; Leviathan remained in operation throughout the war

description: Leviathan and Karish shut 13 June 2025 at government order when Israel attacked Iran; Leviathan restart announced 25 June 2025 after nearly two weeks; supplies to Egypt and Jordan halted to prioritise domestic use; Israeli gas about 15-20 percent of Egypt consumption

description: Leviathan shut 28 Feb 2026 (US-Israeli strikes on Iran) with Chevron force majeure; Israel Energy Ministry announced resumption 2-3 April 2026 after a 32-day halt (other reports 33 days); exports to Egypt and Jordan resumed
source_title: Israel resumes Leviathan gas field operations after 32-day halt due to war (Anadolu 3 Apr 2026) and Chevron Declares Force Majeure as Israel Shuts Leviathan Gas Field (OilPrice 2 Mar 2026)

description: Karish (Energean Power FPSO) production suspended 28 Feb 2026 on Energy Ministry order; restart allowed 9 April 2026; full production within 48 hours; 41-day halt

description: Frequency of government-ordered shutdowns of Israeli offshore gas fields: three episodes in 36 months (Oct 2023 Tamar 35 d; Jun 2025 Leviathan and Karish 12 d; Feb-Apr 2026 Leviathan 33 d and Karish 41 d); no episode found 1 Apr to 30 Sep 2026
statistic: annual hazard of a shutdown episode
source_title: Derived from Times of Israel 14 Nov 2023; The National 25 Jun 2025; Anadolu 3 Apr 2026; Bosphorus News 23 May 2026; Energean H1 2026 release 9 Sep 2026
notes: Shut-in share of time: Leviathan 45 d = 4.1 percent; Karish 53 d = 4.8 percent; Tamar 35 d = 3.2 percent; export halt to Egypt/Jordan at least 45 d = 4.1 percent; episodes cluster with Iran-Israel escalations (Jun 2025 Feb 2026); absence of episodes after April 2026 not guaranteed (search coverage after early August 2026 thin); low/high = exact (Garwood) 80 percent Poisson interval for 3 events in 3 years
